visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro: A woman with long black hair, wearing a white halter top and a long black skirt, sits at the front of a classroom. She holds a silver flute and laughs, covering her mouth with one hand. Behind her, six young girls in school uniforms stand in a row. The background is a large green chalkboard with posters on the right. (2) Challenge Setup: The woman speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with the flute. Digital album cover icons appear floating on the screen. The girls behind her remain standing, looking at the camera or the woman. The lighting is bright and even indoor lighting. (3) Performance Phase: The woman brings the flute to her lips and plays. The camera is static at eye-level. The girls watch her attentively. (4) Guessing Phase: As the woman stops playing, the girls excitedly raise their hands. A girl in a pink shirt on the left is particularly enthusiastic. Bright, colorful text overlays appear at the bottom. (5) Interaction Loop: The woman points to one of the girls, who then speaks. The woman laughs and confirms the answer. This cycle of playing and guessing repeats for several songs, with different song-title text appearing each time. (6) Conclusion: The woman waves to the camera and the girls join in, smiling and waving as the video concludes in the same classroom setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting a class. There is audible background chatter from children and a light indoor room tone. The woman's speech is rapid and cheerful, setting a game-like atmosphere. (2) A sharp transition occurs as the woman plays a bright, melodic phrase on a flute. The flute sound is clear and tonal with a high spectral centroid. The background voices are momentarily quiet during the performance. (3) Upon the music stopping, children's voices erupt in overlapping chatter. A loud, synthetic 'Ding' sound effect plays, followed by the woman's excited confirmation and laughter. This pattern of speech, flute melody, and SFX repeats multiple times. (4) Each musical segment is a different melody played at a moderate tempo. The 'Ding' SFX acts as a structural anchor for each correct guess. Toward the end, the woman's voice rises in pitch to signify a 'bonus' or harder round. (5) The recording concludes with the woman and children saying goodbye in a chaotic, joyful chorus of voices. A final cartoonish sound effect marks the end of the video production.
